title: Tesla Cybercab Crash in Philadelphia Exposes Door Internals
key_facts: A Tesla Cybercab appears to have been in a crash in Philadelphia, and the damage shows the inside of its door.
A Tesla watcher on X describes it as 'a relatively low-speed collision' that knocked off the left door panel.
Photos from a Reddit user show the outer door skin missing, with the inner frame, window regulator, latch, wiring and a side-impact crossbar exposed.
The window glass is intact, the side skirt is crumpled and the rear quarter panel is scuffed.
Philadelphia is not one of Tesla's Robotaxi markets, so the car was likely in validation testing.
Circumstances and fault are not confirmed; an earlier Cybercab was rear-ended in validation testing this spring.
quote_evidence: The exact circumstances of the incident haven’t been confirmed yet, including who was at fault.
Philadelphia isn’t one of Tesla’s Robotaxi markets, so this Cybercab was likely out on validation testing.
why_it_matters_hint: A minor crash shows how the Cybercab door is built; the crash itself is unconfirmed.
event_date: 7 Oct 2026 (feed date); crash date not given
notes: The crash comes from a fan account's X post and Reddit photos. No police or Tesla statement appears in the article.
